I am a 23 year old boy and affected by jadu and jinn mentally and physically am growing weak day by day 2553 views Q. How to overcome out of bad times. 3197 views Q. My boss is a Saudi person. Some 17 years ago, he wrote nasty and annoymous letters against his deputy and circulated widely. The management took serious not, and even though they knew that my boss was the mischievous person sending that letters, they could not take any action, because he being a Saudi and more they did not have any evidence. I as his direct subordinate was asked by the managment to give evidence against my boss that he was the culprit. I knew he was. My boss pleaded not to give anything in writing and that he would get me back, even if I am deported. As a loyal subordinate, I did not give anything in writing, the result, that I and my family underwent lot of humilation, mental and physical torture, agony, persecution, harrassment. Even our dues of 10 years of service was not given. More inhuman was that my three months seriouly handicapped child was not allowed to get medical treatment. All knew that we were innocents, and were sufferring for the acts of my boss. Finally, tired of all the persecution, we adopted to get deported. After my return, my boss is avoided recalling me or helping us getting us justice for all the wrong done and giving us our rightful compensation for the sufferrings and illegal termination. When I call the boss, he gives false promises and avoids my calls. This is nothing but betrayal. Instead of being rewarded,my boss is resorting to these tactics. I and my wife have been writing, appealing to all those who matters, but no one is responsing. All this in a country, which is ruled in the name of Allah, of which the Holy Qur'an is the Constitution, and Shariah is the law. Even people who I had helped, are avoiding and also play dirty games, trying to settle scores. I have more detractors than friends. They all want to give as much as trouble they can. answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 42510 Country: India Title: Dua Question: I am 22 years old I want to marry a very very religious boy, but my family is not very religious. What should I do to get very religious boy for me? Answer ID: 42510 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1758/L=634/TL=1434) Keep on reciting the following dua extensively: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ. In-shaAllah, you shall be married with any pious boy though your family members are not religious minded. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
